mapper.insert: insert into growth_badge (badge_code, badge_name, badge_desc, icon_url, unlock_rule, status, sort_no, club_id, create_time , asset_type , unlock_rule_json , trigger_event) values (#{badgeCode}, #{badgeName}, #{badgeDesc}, #{iconUrl}, #{unlockRule}, #{status}, #{sortNo}, #{clubId}, now() , #{assetType} , #{unlockRuleJson} , #{triggerEvent})
mapper.select: select id, badge_code, badge_name, badge_desc, icon_url, unlock_rule, status, sort_no, club_id, create_time from growth_badge where club_id = #{clubId} order by id desc

select id, badge_code, badge_name, badge_desc, icon_url, unlock_rule, status, sort_no, club_id, create_time, asset_type, badge_style, category, trigger_event, unlock_rule_json, rule_version, rarity, badge_family, name_en, statement, unlock_hint from growth_badge where badge_code = #{badgeCode} limit 1

select id, badge_code, badge_name, badge_desc, icon_url, unlock_rule, status, sort_no, club_id, create_time, asset_type, badge_style, category, trigger_event, unlock_rule_json, rule_version, rarity, badge_family, name_en, statement, unlock_hint from growth_badge where status = '0' and club_id is null order by sort_no

select id, badge_code, badge_name, badge_desc, icon_url, unlock_rule, status, sort_no, club_id, create_time, asset_type, badge_style, category, trigger_event, unlock_rule_json, rule_version, rarity, badge_family, name_en, statement, unlock_hint from growth_badge where status = '0' and club_id is not null and badge_code in #{code} order by sort_no
